product_one_liner.value: Alice helps organizations building GenAI applications, AI agents, and foundation models test, protect, and monitor their AI systems against attacks and unsafe or policy-violating outputs.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation has no pricing link and directs visitors to book a demo.

hq_location.notes: The company also lists Tel Aviv, Israel as a headquarters; this field reports New York.
